messages:
mike: heads-up — saw a spike in fncall-style rejects flagged as schema_rejects on prod this morning. console just shows "structured output error" and no sample payloads.

sarah: ugh. any example invoke id? wondering if telemetry is dropping the payload snapshot when stream closes.

mike: got one: invoke id=abc123. logs indicate stream closed early and tool output ended with a partial JSON fragment.

mike: ```
INVOKE 2026-03-18T12:34:56Z id=abc123 status=stream_closed bytes=512 last_chunk='... "result": {"items": ["ok",'
```

jonah: validator saw truncated JSON -> classified as reject -> routed to schema_reject path -> quota deducted. that matches reports where customers were charged despite a downstream/network early-close.

anya: can we special-case stream_closed + partial-json to mark transient error? at minimum don't decrement customer quota until we confirm it's a true invalid shape.

sarah: two things: (1) new telemetry signal so console differentiates early_close vs invalid-shape, (2) fallback routing tweak — quick retry or route to degen variant before charging full quota.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: proto/invoke-telemetry-tag v1 -> staging at 14:00

mike: minimal telemetry proposal: emit invoke_close_reason enum = [normal_end, stream_closed, downstream_reset, timeout], and last_chunk_preview (max 256 bytes, redacted) so SRE/product can triage without storing full PII.

jonah: last_chunk_preview + validator_error_code='truncated-json' would let dashboards filter quickly.

anya: dashboard gap: current fncall reject panel counts schema_reject but no visibility to close reason or preview. need new column + link to last_chunk_preview and invoke_close_reason.

sarah: UX: console should show a hint like "likely early-close (network) — check invoke_close_reason" and an action to re-run the sample. product ok?

anya: propose CTA "replay sample" that replays the request against a canary model/route in a sandbox. needs RBAC + cost estimate before run.

mike: quota rule proposal: if invoke_close_reason != normal_end then do not decrement customer token quota; mark record transient_chargeable=false. mirrors how we treat client disconnects for streaming endpoints.

jonah: abuse risk: attacker could craft truncated output to avoid charges. restrict waive to cases where close_reason in [stream_closed, downstream_reset] AND bytes < 2KB. add anomaly detector: if >3 such waive events from same customer in 1m, re-enable charging and alert.

sarah: rollout plan: telemetry + console UI to staging -> dogfood -> soft rollout to 10% customers for 24h -> monitor anomaly rate and billing impact -> full rollout if OK.

anya: assign: jonah -> impl validator tag & transient detection (draft PR EOD), sarah -> console UI copy + replay CTA mock (EOD), mike -> quota policy doc + billing sync (tomorrow), anya -> dashboard column + alert rule (this week).

mike: also update runbook with steps for repeated truncated-json pattern: https://go/runbooks/invoke-truncate

jonah: logs: add finalizer line INV_FINALIZE id=%s close_reason=%s bytes=%d truncated_preview='%s' for cross-infra correlation.

sarah: deploy-bot: can we stage console mock for PM review? (sarah -> pm-preview)

deploy-bot: deploy started: proto/invoke-telemetry-tag v1 -> staging

mike: marking this P0 for observability work; will follow up with PR links.

jonah: PR (draft): https://git.redwood/infer/validator/pulls/712 — adds validator_error_code + invoke_close_reason emit

anya: patching dashboard now and will drop a mock CTA screenshot in #pm-preview.

mike: leaving thread open until staging metrics look good.
